title.zh: 在达沃市Tugbok区Mintal描笼涯设立Mintal综合中学并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act to Establish the Mintal Comprehensive High School in Barangay Mintal, Tugbok District, Davao City, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act to Establish the Mintal Comprehensive High School in Barangay Mintal, Tugbok District, Davao City, and Appropriating Funds Therefor

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1994/ra_7739_1994.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There shall be established in Barangay Mintal, Tugbok District, Davao City, a comprehensive high school to be known as the Mintal Comprehensive High School under the supervision of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports.
The Secretary of Education, Culture and Sports shall formulate the necessary rules and regulations implementing this Act.

The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be funded out of the appropriations authorized by Republic Act No. 7663 for the Department of Education, Culture and Sports intended for the operational expenses of newly legislated high schools. Thereafter, the amount needed for its operation and maintenance shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 4, 1994.
